decisions.decision: Use Stack+AnimatedOpacity instead of conditional widget tree mutation
decisions.rationale: AnimatedOpacity(opacity:0) sets RenderOpacity.needsCompositing=false, bypassing BackdropFilter GPU cost without removing widgets from tree. No tree mutation = no relayout spike.
Column -> outer RepaintBoundary -> TitleBar -> blur/content RepaintBoundaries. Content completely shielded from resize-triggered repaints.
Masks 1-frame stale-bitmap flash when resize ends and blur reappears. Imperceptible to humans.

decisions.decision: Keep Impeller enabled via _putenv_s in main.cpp
decisions.rationale: Confirmed correct approach for standalone/release builds. Sets env vars before engine creation.

context_notes: Applied plan from vivid-weaving-ripple.md. All code changes complete, all 327 tests pass. The key insight: BackdropFilter tree mutation (mount/unmount) was causing relayout spikes during resize. Stack+AnimatedOpacity keeps it always mounted but skips compositing when opacity=0. Three RepaintBoundary instances provide complete isolation. User needs to manually verify the fix works on their display.
